seizures.description: NCB seized 349 kg of high-grade cocaine worth Rs 1,745 crore in Mumbai, one of the largest operations. Connected to arrest of Salim Dola, aide of Dawood Ibrahim, deported from Turkey.
Punjab Police arrested six persons and recovered more than 30 kg of heroin. Linked to Dubai-based smuggler. Cross-border cartel dismantled.
National cocaine seizures reached 1,483 kg in 2024, a 78x increase from 2020 and 5x higher than 2023. Major interceptions in Delhi and Maharashtra.
Punjab seized 1,150 kg of heroin accounting for 44.5% of India's total heroin seizures in 2024.
Gujarat seized 24,000 kg of narcotics worth Rs 7,303 crore in 2024. Most shipments were meant for Punjab. 848 individuals booked under NDPS Act.
Drone-driven drug smuggling cases along India-Pakistan border in Punjab surged from 3 (2021) to 179 (2024). 179 seizures via drones in 2024.
1,882 kg mephedrone seized across Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Madhya Pradesh in coordinated operations.
NCB 2024 seizures: 17,420 kg ganja (cannabis). Cannabis accounts for ~41% of total narcotic substances confiscated.
NCB 2024 seizures: 3,391 kg hashish (cannabis resin).
NCB 2024 seizures: 170 kg heroin.
NCB 2024 seizures: 11,376 kg acetic anhydride (precursor chemical used in heroin manufacturing).
NCB 2024 seizures: 88 kg cocaine.
Maritime seizures: 10,564 kg of narcotics in 2024.
Amphetamine-type stimulants (ATS/meth) seized: 8,406 kg in 2024 nationally.
Gujarat: 757 individuals arrested in NDPS cases in 2024.
